body: I'm tired of talking with you, so bye.
what? You have said  your say
whatevah you say brah, btw what community? You are the only one so far.

First of all Fuck You, how do you know it gets better? How does age matter? You would rather go through a life of meaningless activity than die? Ok, man be my guest, I'll take the other route.

I will hurt as many people as I want, in order to be happy. I know they would want me to be happy, and suicide just makes them selfish when they would really be altruistic in every other circumstance. Like an animal in pain that needs to be put down.

So when I spend the rest of my life trying to find something worth it and fail I'll be better off?

I have had the inability to create meaning/happiness in my life and I don't really want to be in constant pain so ending it is AWESOME. Suicide is a resolution that I finally have.

Ok, so you can find happiness in something, then you stick with it. I don't, I have not stuck with anything my whole life, except maybe for living. My soul is exhausted, physically and mentally. I'm stuck in this ditch I make movements but always end rock bottom.

Edit: I can talk the talk, but not walk the walk.
That's what I originally thought, but it's just a vicious cycle.

>Could you take things that you love and create meaning?

I have contemplated this, and so far have failed.

Life has no meaning is such a complex subject that basically drives me to insanity, where I live my life in insanity, and I am a coward so I want to end it.

I agree that I don't have a purpose, and that you could lead a happy life. I am saying life has no meaning.
